title: Does Cristiano Ronaldo's Electric Shock Ab Belt Work?
hook: Cristiano Ronaldo will sell you a belt that shocks your abs. But does it really work?
body:
These belts can actually develop your abs. But shocking yourself hard enough to do it is more difficult than just working out. So you're not saving yourself any effort. If you're going to suffer either way, do the workout.

And a belt does nothing about your belly fat. Fat doesn't come off one spot of your body, so shocking your abs isn't going to take the fat off your stomach.

If you want to buy something for your abs, buy an ab wheel instead. I love the ab wheel because it only costs $17, and it trains every ab muscle at once.
